name: search_gifs
description: Search Giphy for GIFs by keyword. Returns title, URL, rating, and multiple image sizes.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1–25, default 10)

name: trending_gifs
description: Get currently trending GIFs on Giphy. Returns title, URL, rating, and multiple image sizes.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1–25, default 10)

name: random_gif
description: Get a random GIF, optionally filtered by tag (e.g., "cats"). Returns title, URL, rating, and image URLs.

tag.description: Optional tag to filter by, e.g. "dogs" or "anime"
